query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2026-11-01) and TimeGenerated <= datetime(2026-11-04T08:15:01.032739+00:00) | where _ResourceId =~ "/subscriptions/aa28274d-fea0-46d4-b9c8-30f3ef0a0e52/resourceGroups/IDS-TOKEN-EXCHANGE-POC/providers/Microsoft.ApiManagement/service/poc-ids-token-ex-apim" | mv-expand record=TraceRecords | where tostring(record.source) == "aiflux" | extend m=parse_json(tostring(record.metadata)) | summarize traces=count() by category=tostring(m.category) | order by category asc
